n8n git node disable bare repos

services.name: Grafana
services.description: Grafana is the open source analytics & monitoring solution for every database.
services.compose:
services:
    grafana:
        environment:
            GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_GRAFANA}
            GF_SERVER_DOMAIN: ${SERVICE_FQDN_GRAFANA}
            GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_GRAFANA}
            SERVICE_FQDN_GRAFANA_3000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_GRAFANA_3000}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - -f
                - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health
            timeout: 20s
        image: grafana/grafana-oss
        volumes:
            - source: data-grafana-0
              target: /var/lib/grafana
              type: volume
volumes:
    data-grafana-0: {}

services.name: Immich
services.description: Self-hosted photo and video management solution.
services.compose:
services:
    database:
        environment:
            DB_STORAGE_TYPE: ${DB_STORAGE_TYPE:-SSD}
            POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME:-immich}
            POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: --data-checksums
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 20s
        image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.3.0-pgvectors0.2.0
        volumes:
            - source: data-database-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    immich:
        depends_on:
            database:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DB_DATA_LOCATION: ./postgres
            DB_DATABASE_NAME: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME:-immich}
            DB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            DB_USERNAME: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
            SERVICE_FQDN_IMMICH_2283: ${SERVICE_FQDN_IMMICH_2283}
            TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
            UPLOAD_LOCATION: ./library
        healthcheck:
            disable: false
        image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
        volumes:
            - source: data-immich-0
              target: /usr/src/app/upload
              type: volume
    immich-machine-learning:
        environment:
            DB_DATA_LOCATION: ./postgres
            DB_DATABASE_NAME: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME:-immich}
            DB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            DB_USERNAME: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
            TZ: ${TZ:-Etc/UTC}
            UPLOAD_LOCATION: ./library
        healthcheck:
            disable: false
        image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
        volumes:
            - source: data-immich-machine-learning-0
              target: /cache
              type: volume
    redis:
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 20
            test:
                - CMD
                - redis-cli
                - PING
            timeout: 10s
        image: redis:7.4-alpine
volumes:
    data-database-0: {}
    data-immich-0: {}
    data-immich-machine-learning-0: {}

services.name: Supabase
services.description: The open source Firebase alternative.
services.supportNote: Needs host access and local configuration files after deploy
services.compose:
services:
    imgproxy:
        environment:
            IMGPROXY_AUTO_WEBP: ${IMGPROXY_AUTO_WEBP:-true}
            IMGPROXY_BIND: :8080
            IMGPROXY_LOCAL_FILESYSTEM_ROOT: /
            IMGPROXY_MAX_SRC_RESOLUTION: "16.8"
            IMGPROXY_USE_ETAG: "true"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - imgproxy
                - health
            timeout: 5s
        image: darthsim/imgproxy:v3.30.1
        volumes:
            - source: data-imgproxy-0
              target: /var/lib/storage
              type: volume
    minio-createbucket:
        depends_on:
            supabase-minio:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - /entrypoint.sh
        environment:
            MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
            MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
        image: pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-10-15T00-00-00Z
        restart: "no"
        volumes:
            - source: data-minio-createbucket-0
              target: /entrypoint.sh
              type: volume
    realtime-dev:
        command: |
            sh -c "/app/bin/migrate && /app/bin/realtime eval 'Realtime.Release.seeds(Realtime.Repo)' && /app/bin/server"
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            API_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            APP_NAME: realtime
            DB_AFTER_CONNECT_QUERY: SET search_path TO _realtime
            DB_ENC_KEY: supabaserealtime
            DB_HOST: ${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}
            DB_NAME: ${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            DB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            DB_PORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
            DB_USER: supabase_admin
            DISABLE_HEALTHCHECK_LOGGING: "true"
            DNS_NODES: ''''''
            ERL_AFLAGS: -proto_dist inet_tcp
            JANITOR_INTERVAL: "60000"
            LOG_LEVEL: error
            METRICS_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            PORT: "4000"
            RLIMIT_NOFILE: "10000"
            RUN_JANITOR: "true"
            SECRET_KEY_BASE: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_REALTIME}
            SEED_SELF_HOST: "true"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - -sSfL
                - --head
                - -o
                - /dev/null
                - -H
                - 'Authorization: Bearer ${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}'
                - http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/tenants/realtime-dev/health
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/realtime:v2.76.5
    supabase-analytics:
        depends_on:
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DB_DATABASE: _supabase
            DB_HOSTNAME: ${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}
            DB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            DB_PORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
            DB_SCHEMA: _analytics
            DB_USERNAME: supabase_admin
            LOGFLARE_FEATURE_FLAG_OVERRIDE: multibackend=true
            LOGFLARE_NODE_HOST: 127.0.0.1
            LOGFLARE_PRIVATE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_LOGFLAREPRIVATE}
            LOGFLARE_PUBLIC_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_LOGFLARE}
            LOGFLARE_SINGLE_TENANT: "true"
            LOGFLARE_SUPABASE_MODE: "true"
            POSTGRES_BACKEND_SCHEMA: _analytics
            POSTGRES_BACKEND_URL: postgresql://supabase_admin:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}/_supabase
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - http://127.0.0.1:4000/health
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/logflare:1.31.2
    supabase-auth:
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            API_EXTERNAL_URL: ${API_EXTERNAL_URL:-http://supabase-kong:8000}
            GOTRUE_API_HOST: 0.0.0.0
            GOTRUE_API_PORT: "9999"
            GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL: postgres://supabase_auth_admin:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}/${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            GOTRUE_DB_DRIVER: postgres
            GOTRUE_DISABLE_SIGNUP: ${DISABLE_SIGNUP:-false}
            GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_ANONYMOUS_USERS_ENABLED: ${ENABLE_ANONYMOUS_USERS:-false}
            GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED: ${ENABLE_EMAIL_SIGNUP:-true}
            GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_PHONE_ENABLED: ${ENABLE_PHONE_SIGNUP:-true}
            GOTRUE_JWT_ADMIN_ROLES: service_role
            GOTRUE_JWT_AUD: authenticated
            GOTRUE_JWT_DEFAULT_GROUP_NAME: authenticated
            GOTRUE_JWT_EXP: ${JWT_EXPIRY:-3600}
            GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM: ${ENABLE_EMAIL_AUTOCONFIRM:-false}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_SUBJECTS_CONFIRMATION: ${MAILER_SUBJECTS_CONFIRMATION}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_SUBJECTS_EMAIL_CHANGE: ${MAILER_SUBJECTS_EMAIL_CHANGE}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_SUBJECTS_INVITE: ${MAILER_SUBJECTS_INVITE}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_SUBJECTS_MAGIC_LINK: ${MAILER_SUBJECTS_MAGIC_LINK}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_SUBJECTS_RECOVERY: ${MAILER_SUBJECTS_RECOVERY}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_TEMPLATES_CONFIRMATION: ${MAILER_TEMPLATES_CONFIRMATION}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_TEMPLATES_EMAIL_CHANGE: ${MAILER_TEMPLATES_EMAIL_CHANGE}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_TEMPLATES_INVITE: ${MAILER_TEMPLATES_INVITE}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_TEMPLATES_MAGIC_LINK: ${MAILER_TEMPLATES_MAGIC_LINK}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_TEMPLATES_RECOVERY: ${MAILER_TEMPLATES_RECOVERY}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_URLPATHS_CONFIRMATION: ${MAILER_URLPATHS_CONFIRMATION:-/auth/v1/verify}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_URLPATHS_EMAIL_CHANGE: ${MAILER_URLPATHS_EMAIL_CHANGE:-/auth/v1/verify}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_URLPATHS_INVITE: ${MAILER_URLPATHS_INVITE:-/auth/v1/verify}
            GOTRUE_MAILER_URLPATHS_RECOVERY: ${MAILER_URLPATHS_RECOVERY:-/auth/v1/verify}
            GOTRUE_SITE_URL: ${GOTRUE_SITE_URL:-${SERVICE_FQDN_SUPABASEKONG}}
            GOTRUE_SMS_AUTOCONFIRM: ${ENABLE_PHONE_AUTOCONFIRM:-true}
            GOTRUE_SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL}
            GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST: ${SMTP_HOST}
            GOTRUE_SMTP_PASS: ${SMTP_PASS}
            GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT: ${SMTP_PORT:-587}
            GOTRUE_SMTP_SENDER_NAME: ${SMTP_SENDER_NAME}
            GOTRUE_SMTP_USER: ${SMTP_USER}
            GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST: ${ADDITIONAL_REDIRECT_URLS}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - wget
                - --no-verbose
                - --tries=1
                - --spider
                - http://127.0.0.1:9999/health
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/gotrue:v2.186.0
    supabase-db:
        command:
            - postgres
            - -c
            - config_file=/etc/postgresql/postgresql.conf
            - -c
            - log_min_messages=fatal
        depends_on:
            supabase-vector:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            JWT_EXP: ${JWT_EXPIRY:-3600}
            JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            PGDATABASE: ${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            PGPASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            PGPORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            POSTGRES_HOST: /var/run/postgresql
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_PORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test: pg_isready -U postgres -h 127.0.0.1
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/postgres:15.8.1.085
        volumes:
            - source: data-supabase-db-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-1
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/migrations/99-realtime.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-2
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/migrations/97-_supabase.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-3
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/migrations/99-pooler.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-4
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-scripts/98-webhooks.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-5
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-scripts/99-roles.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-6
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-scripts/99-jwt.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-7
              target: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/migrations/99-logs.sql
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-db-8
              target: /etc/postgresql-custom
              type: volume
    supabase-edge-functions:
        command:
            - start
            - --main-service
            - /home/deno/functions/main
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}
            SUPABASE_DB_URL: postgresql://postgres:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}/${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            SUPABASE_PUBLIC_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SUPABASEKONG}
            SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASESERVICE_KEY}
            SUPABASE_URL: http://supabase-kong:8000
            VERIFY_JWT: ${FUNCTIONS_VERIFY_JWT:-false}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - echo
                - Edge Functions is healthy
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/edge-runtime:v1.71.2
        volumes:
            - source: data-supabase-edge-functions-0
              target: /home/deno/functions
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-edge-functions-1
              target: /root/.cache/deno
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-edge-functions-2
              target: /home/deno/functions/main/index.ts
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-edge-functions-3
              target: /home/deno/functions/hello/index.ts
              type: volume
    supabase-kong:
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint: /home/kong/kong-entrypoint.sh
        environment:
            ANON_KEY_ASYMMETRIC: ${ANON_KEY_ASYMMETRIC:-}
            DASHBOARD_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}
            DASHBOARD_USERNAME: ${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}
            JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            KONG_DATABASE: "off"
            KONG_DECLARATIVE_CONFIG: /usr/local/kong/kong.yml
            KONG_DNS_NOT_FOUND_TTL: "1"
            KONG_DNS_ORDER: LAST,A,CNAME
            KONG_NGINX_PROXY_PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE: 160k
            KONG_NGINX_PROXY_PROXY_BUFFERS: 64 160k
            KONG_PLUGINS: request-transformer,cors,key-auth,acl,basic-auth,request-termination,ip-restriction,post-function
            KONG_PORT_MAPS: 443:8000
            KONG_PROXY_ACCESS_LOG: /dev/stdout combined
            KONG_STORAGE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT: ${KONG_STORAGE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-60}
            KONG_STORAGE_READ_TIMEOUT: ${KONG_STORAGE_READ_TIMEOUT:-3600}
            KONG_STORAGE_REQUEST_BUFFERING: ${KONG_STORAGE_REQUEST_BUFFERING:-false}
            KONG_STORAGE_RESPONSE_BUFFERING: ${KONG_STORAGE_RESPONSE_BUFFERING:-false}
            KONG_STORAGE_WRITE_TIMEOUT: ${KONG_STORAGE_WRITE_TIMEOUT:-3600}
            SERVICE_FQDN_SUPABASEKONG_8000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SUPABASEKONG_8000}
            SERVICE_ROLE_KEY_ASYMMETRIC: ${SERVICE_ROLE_KEY_ASYMMETRIC:-}
            SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}
            SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-}
            SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY: ${SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY:-}
            SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASESERVICE_KEY}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD
                - kong
                - health
            timeout: 5s
        image: kong/kong:3.9.1
        volumes:
            - source: data-supabase-kong-0
              target: /home/kong/kong-entrypoint.sh
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-kong-1
              target: /home/kong/temp.yml
              type: volume
    supabase-meta:
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            CRYPTO_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_PGMETACRYPTO}
            PG_META_DB_HOST: ${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}
            PG_META_DB_NAME: ${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            PG_META_DB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            PG_META_DB_PORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
            PG_META_DB_USER: supabase_admin
            PG_META_PORT: "8080"
        image: supabase/postgres-meta:v0.95.2
    supabase-minio:
        command: server --console-address ":9001" /data
        environment:
            MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
            MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - mc
                - ready
                - local
            timeout: 20s
        image: pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-10-15T00-00-00Z
        volumes:
            - source: data-supabase-minio-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
    supabase-rest:
        command: postgrest
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            PGRST_APP_SETTINGS_JWT_EXP: ${JWT_EXPIRY:-3600}
            PGRST_APP_SETTINGS_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE: anon
            PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH: ${PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH:-public}
            PGRST_DB_MAX_ROWS: ${PGRST_DB_MAX_ROWS:-1000}
            PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS: ${PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS:-public,storage,graphql_public}
            PGRST_DB_URI: postgres://authenticator:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}/${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            PGRST_DB_USE_LEGACY_GUCS: "false"
            PGRST_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
        image: postgrest/postgrest:v14.6
    supabase-storage:
        depends_on:
            imgproxy:
                condition: service_started
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy
            supabase-rest:
                condition: service_started
        environment:
            ANON_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}
            AUTH_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
            AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
            DATABASE_SEARCH_PATH: storage
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://supabase_storage_admin:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@${POSTGRES_HOSTNAME:-supabase-db}:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}/${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            DB_INSTALL_ROLES: "false"
            ENABLE_IMAGE_TRANSFORMATION: "true"
            IMGPROXY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: "15"
            IMGPROXY_URL: http://imgproxy:8080
            MULTI_TENANT: "false"
            NODE_ENV: production
            PGRST_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            POSTGREST_URL: http://supabase-rest:3000
            REQUEST_ALLOW_X_FORWARDED_PATH: "true"
            SERVER_PORT: "5000"
            SERVER_REGION: local
            SERVICE_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASESERVICE_KEY}
            STORAGE_BACKEND: s3
            STORAGE_PUBLIC_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SUPABASEKONG}
            STORAGE_S3_BUCKET: stub
            STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT: http://supabase-minio:9000
            STORAGE_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: "true"
            STORAGE_S3_REGION: us-east-1
            TENANT_ID: ${STORAGE_TENANT_ID:-storage-single-tenant}
            TUS_MAX_SIZE: "3600000"
            TUS_URL_PATH: /upload/resumable
            UPLOAD_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT: "524288000"
            UPLOAD_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT_STANDARD: "524288000"
            UPLOAD_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRATION_TIME: "120"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - wget
                - --no-verbose
                - --tries=1
                - --spider
                - http://127.0.0.1:5000/status
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/storage-api:v1.44.2
        volumes:
            - source: data-supabase-storage-0
              target: /var/lib/storage
              type: volume
    supabase-studio:
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            AUTH_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_NAME: ${STUDIO_DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION:-Default Organization}
            DEFAULT_PROJECT_NAME: ${STUDIO_DEFAULT_PROJECT:-Default Project}
            EDGE_FUNCTIONS_MANAGEMENT_FOLDER: /app/edge-functions
            HOSTNAME: 0.0.0.0
            LOGFLARE_API_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_LOGFLARE}
            LOGFLARE_PRIVATE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_LOGFLAREPRIVATE}
            LOGFLARE_PUBLIC_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_LOGFLARE}
            LOGFLARE_URL: http://supabase-analytics:4000
            NEXT_ANALYTICS_BACKEND_PROVIDER: postgres
            NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_LOGS: "true"
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SUPABASEKONG}
            OPENAI_API_KEY: ${OPENAI_API_KEY}
            PG_META_CRYPTO_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_PGMETACRYPTO}
            PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH: ${PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH:-public}
            PGRST_DB_MAX_ROWS: ${PGRST_DB_MAX_ROWS:-1000}
            PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS: ${PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS:-public,storage,graphql_public}
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
            POSTGRES_HOST: ${POSTGRES_HOST:-supabase-db}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_PORT: ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
            SNIPPETS_MANAGEMENT_FOLDER: /app/snippets
            STUDIO_PG_META_URL: http://supabase-meta:8080

            SUPABASE_URL: http://supabase-kong:8000
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - node
                - -e
                - fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/platform/profile').then((r) => {if (r.status !== 200) throw new Error(r.status)})
            timeout: 5s
        image: supabase/studio:2026.03.16-sha-5528817
        volumes:
            - source: data-supabase-studio-0
              target: /app/snippets
              type: volume
            - source: data-supabase-studio-1
              target: /app/edge-functions
              type: volume
    supabase-supavisor:
        command:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              if [ ! -f /etc/ssl/server.crt ]; then
                openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 3650 -newkey rsa:2048 \
                  -keyout /etc/ssl/server.key -out /etc/ssl/server.crt \
                  -subj "/CN=supabase-pooler"
              fi
              /app/bin/migrate && /app/bin/supavisor eval "$$(cat /etc/pooler/pooler.exs)" && /app/bin/server
        depends_on:
            supabase-analytics:
                condition: service_healthy
            supabase-db:
                condition: service_healthy

            POOLER_POOL_MODE: transaction

services.name: AFFiNE
services.description: Affine is an open-source, all-in-one workspace and OS for knowledge management, a Notion/Miro alternative.
services.compose:
services:
    affine:
        depends_on:
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            AFFINE_CONFIG_PATH: /root/.affine/config
            AFFINE_SERVER_EXTERNAL_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_AFFINE}
            AFFINE_SERVER_HOST: ${SERVICE_FQDN_AFFINE}
            COPILOT_FAL_API_KEY: ${COPILOT_FAL_API_KEY}
            COPILOT_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${COPILOT_OPENAI_API_KEY}
            COPILOT_PERPLEXITY_API_KEY: ${COPILOT_PERPLEXITY_API_KEY}
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-affine}
            MAILER_HOST: ${MAILER_HOST}
            MAILER_PASSWORD: ${MAILER_PASSWORD}
            MAILER_PORT: ${MAILER_PORT}
            MAILER_SENDER: ${MAILER_SENDER}
            MAILER_USER: ${MAILER_USER}
            NODE_ENV: production
            REDIS_SERVER_HOST: redis
            SERVICE_FQDN_AFFINE_3010: ${SERVICE_FQDN_AFFINE_3010}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - bash -c ':> /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/3010' || exit 1
            timeout: 20s
        image: ghcr.io/toeverything/affine:stable
        logging:
            driver: json-file
            options:
                max-size: 1000m
        volumes:
            - source: data-affine-0
              target: /root/.affine/config
              type: volume
            - source: data-affine-1
              target: /root/.affine/storage
              type: volume
    affine_migration:
        command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - node ./scripts/self-host-predeploy.js
        depends_on:
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            AFFINE_INDEXER_ENABLED: "false"
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-affine}
            REDIS_SERVER_HOST: redis
        image: ghcr.io/toeverything/affine:${AFFINE_REVISION:-stable}
        restart: on-failure
        volumes:
            - source: data-affine-migration-0
              target: /root/.affine/storage
              type: volume
            - source: data-affine-migration-1
              target: /root/.affine/config
              type: volume
    postgres:
        environment:
            PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-affine}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 20s
        image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
        volumes:
            - source: data-postgres-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    redis:
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD
                - redis-cli
                - --raw
                - incr
                - ping
            timeout: 5s
        image: redis
        volumes:
            - source: data-redis-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
volumes:
    data-affine-0: {}
    data-affine-1: {}
    data-affine-migration-0: {}
    data-affine-migration-1: {}
    data-postgres-0: {}
    data-redis-0: {}

services.name: AppFlowy
services.description: AppFlowy is the AI collaborative workspace where you achieve more without losing control of your data.

services:

            APPFLOWY_S3_REGION: ${APPFLOWY_S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
            APPFLOWY_S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
            AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY}
            AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION: ${AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION}
            AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: ${AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT}

            DEFAULT_AI_MODEL: gpt-4.1-mini
            OPENAI_API_KEY: ${AI_OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
        image: appflowyinc/appflowy_ai:0.9.149
    appflowy_cloud:
        depends_on:
            gotrue:
                condition: service_healthy
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_started
        environment:
            AI_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${AI_OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
            AI_SERVER_HOST: ai
            AI_SERVER_PORT: "5001"
            APPFLOWY_ACCESS_CONTROL: "true"
            APPFLOWY_BASE_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_ADMIN}

            APPFLOWY_GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}
            APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_EMAIL: ${APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_EMAIL:-notify@appflowy.io}
            APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_HOST: ${APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_HOST:-smtp.gmail.com}
            APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_PASSWORD: ${APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_PASSWORD:-email_sender_password}
            APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_PORT: ${APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_PORT:-587}
            APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_TLS_KIND: ${APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_TLS_KIND:-none}
            APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_USERNAME: ${APPFLOWY_MAILER_SMTP_USERNAME:-notify@appflowy.io}
            APPFLOWY_REDIS_URI: redis://redis:6379
            APPFLOWY_S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
            APPFLOWY_S3_BUCKET: ${APPFLOWY_S3_BUCKET:-appflowy}
            APPFLOWY_S3_CREATE_BUCKET: ${APPFLOWY_S3_CREATE_BUCKET:-true}

            APPFLOWY_WORKER_IMPORT_TICK_INTERVAL: "30"

        healthcheck:
            interval: 15s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD
                - wget
                - --spider
                - -qO-
                - http://localhost:4002/health
            timeout: 15s
        image: budibase.docker.scarf.sh/budibase/apps
    couchdb-service:
        environment:
            COUCHDB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_COUCHDB}
            COUCHDB_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_COUCHDB}

        healthcheck:

            start_period: 10s
            test:

                - curl
                - -f

        volumes:
            - source: data-minio-service-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
    proxy-service:
        depends_on:
            - minio-service
            - worker-service
            - app-service
            - couchdb-service
        environment:
            APPS_UPSTREAM_URL: http://app-service:4002
            COUCHDB_UPSTREAM_URL: http://couchdb-service:5984
            MINIO_UPSTREAM_URL: http://minio-service:9000
            PROXY_RATE_LIMIT_API_PER_SECOND: "20"
            PROXY_RATE_LIMIT_WEBHOOKS_PER_SECOND: "10"
            RESOLVER: 127.0.0.11
            SERVICE_FQDN_BUDIBASE_10000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_BUDIBASE_10000}
            WORKER_UPSTREAM_URL: http://worker-service:4003
        healthcheck:
            interval: 15s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - -f
                - http://localhost:10000/
            timeout: 15s
        image: budibase/proxy
    redis-service:
        command: redis-server --requirepass "$SERVICE_PASSWORD_REDIS"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 15s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD

                - ping
            timeout: 15s
        image: redis
        volumes:
            - source: data-redis-service-0

    worker-service:

services:

        depends_on:

                condition: service_healthy
            minio-init:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            BUZZ_ALLOW_NIP_OA_AUTH: ${BUZZ_ALLOW_NIP_OA_AUTH:-true}
            BUZZ_AUTO_MIGRATE: ${BUZZ_AUTO_MIGRATE:-true}
            BUZZ_BIND_ADDR: 0.0.0.0:3000
            BUZZ_CORS_ORIGINS: ${SERVICE_FQDN_BUZZ},tauri://localhost,http://tauri.localhost
            BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE: ${BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE:-true}
            BUZZ_GIT_HOOK_HMAC_SECRET: ${SERVICE_HEX_64_GITHMAC}
            BUZZ_GIT_REPO_PATH: /data/git
            BUZZ_HEALTH_PORT: "8080"
            BUZZ_MEDIA_BASE_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_BUZZ}/media
            BUZZ_MEDIA_SERVER_DOMAIN: ${SERVICE_FQDN_BUZZ}
            BUZZ_METRICS_PORT: "9102"
            BUZZ_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY: ${SERVICE_HEX_64_RELAYKEY}
            BUZZ_REQUIRE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${BUZZ_REQUIRE_AUTH_TOKEN:-true}
            BUZZ_REQUIRE_RELAY_MEMBERSHIP: ${BUZZ_REQUIRE_RELAY_MEMBERSHIP:-false}
            BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
            BUZZ_S3_BUCKET: ${BUZZ_S3_BUCKET:-buzz-media}
            BUZZ_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
            BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-buzz}
            REDIS_URL: redis://:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_REDIS}@redis:6379
            RELAY_OWNER_PUBKEY: ${RELAY_OWNER_PUBKEY}
            RELAY_URL: wss://${SERVICE_FQDN_BUZZ}
            RUST_LOG: ${RUST_LOG:-buzz_relay=info,buzz_db=info,buzz_auth=info,buzz_pubsub=info,tower_http=info}
            SERVICE_FQDN_BUZZ_3000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_BUZZ_3000}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 12
            start_period: 45s
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/_readiness >/dev/null || exit 1
            timeout: 5s
        image: ghcr.io/block/buzz:${BUZZ_TAG:-main}
        volumes:
            - source: data-buzz-0
              target: /data/git
              type: volume
    minio:
        command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
        environment:
            MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
            MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 12
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD
                - mc
                - ready
                - local
            timeout: 5s
        image: pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-10-15T00-00-00Z
        volumes:
            - source: data-minio-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
    minio-init:
        depends_on:
            minio:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - /bin/sh
            - -euc
            - |-
              mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$${BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY}" "$${BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY}"
              mc mb --ignore-existing "local/$${BUZZ_S3_BUCKET}"
              mc anonymous set none "local/$${BUZZ_S3_BUCKET}"
        environment:
            BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${SERVICE_USER_MINIO}
            BUZZ_S3_BUCKET: ${BUZZ_S3_BUCKET:-buzz-media}
            BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MINIO}
        image: pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-10-15T00-00-00Z
        restart: "no"
    postgres:
        environment:
            PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-buzz}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 12
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 5s
        image: postgres:17-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-postgres-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    redis:
        command:
            - redis-server
            - --appendonly
            - "yes"
            - --requirepass
            - ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_REDIS}
        environment:
            REDIS_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_REDIS}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 12
            start_period: 5s
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - redis-cli -a "$${REDIS_PASSWORD}" ping | grep -q PONG
            timeout: 3s
        image: redis:7-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-redis-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
volumes:
    data-buzz-0: {}
    data-minio-0: {}
    data-postgres-0: {}
    data-redis-0: {}

services.name: Documenso
services.description: Document signing, finally open source
services.supportNote: Review 25 configuration fields before deploying
services.compose:
services:
    database:
        environment:
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-documenso-db}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 20s
        image: postgres:17
        volumes:
            - source: data-database-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    documenso:
        depends_on:
            database:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
            - |
              CERT_PASSPHRASE="$${NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PASSPHRASE}"
              PASSPHRASE_FILE="/tmp/cert_passphrase"

              # Save original working directory
              ORIGINAL_DIR="$$(pwd)"

              # Find openssl binary (should be available in v1.12.10+)
              OPENSSL_CMD="$$(which openssl 2>/dev/null || command -v openssl 2>/dev/null || echo '/usr/bin/openssl')"

              # Verify openssl is available
              if ! $$OPENSSL_CMD version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Error: OpenSSL not found. Please use Documenso image v1.12.10 or later."
                exit 1
              fi

              # Create certificate directory - use /app/certs (writable by user 1001)
              CERT_DIR="/app/certs"
              mkdir -p "$$CERT_DIR" || {
                # Fallback to tmp if app directory not writable
                CERT_DIR="/tmp/certs"
                mkdir -p "$$CERT_DIR"
                echo "Warning: Using fallback directory: $$CERT_DIR"
              }

              # Create passphrase file for secure handling (prevents exposure in process list)
              # This avoids shell word-splitting issues and prevents passphrase from appearing in ps/process list
              echo -n "$$CERT_PASSPHRASE" > "$$PASSPHRASE_FILE"
              chmod 600 "$$PASSPHRASE_FILE"

              touch /tmp/cert_info_path
              cat <<EOF > /tmp/cert_info_path
              [ req ]
              distinguished_name = req_distinguished_name
              prompt = no
              [ req_distinguished_name ]
              C            = ${CERT_INFO_COUNTRY_NAME}
              ST           = ${CERT_INFO_STATE_OR_PROVIDENCE}
              L            = ${CERT_INFO_LOCALITY_NAME}
              O            = ${CERT_INFO_ORGANIZATION_NAME}
              OU           = ${CERT_INFO_ORGANIZATIONAL_UNIT}
              CN           = ${SERVICE_FQDN_DOCUMENSO}
              emailAddress = ${CERT_INFO_EMAIL}
              EOF

              cd "$$CERT_DIR"

              $$OPENSSL_CMD genrsa -out private.key 2048

              $$OPENSSL_CMD req \
                -new \
                -x509 \
                -key private.key \
                -out certificate.crt \
                -days $${CERT_VALID_DAYS} \
                -config /tmp/cert_info_path

              # Create P12 certificate using file-based passphrase (prevents exposure in process list)
              # Private key is not encrypted, so we only need -passout (not -passin)
              $$OPENSSL_CMD pkcs12 \
                -export \
                -out cert.p12 \
                -inkey private.key \
                -in certificate.crt \
                -legacy \
                -passout file:"$$PASSPHRASE_FILE"

              # Clean up passphrase file immediately after use
              rm -f "$$PASSPHRASE_FILE"

              # Set permissions (may fail if not root, but will work in Coolify)
              chown 1001:1001 cert.p12 private.key certificate.crt 2>/dev/null || true
              chmod 400 cert.p12 private.key certificate.crt

              # Update environment variable if directory changed
              if [ "$$CERT_DIR" != "/app/certs" ]; then
                export NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PATH="$$CERT_DIR/cert.p12"
              fi

              # Return to original directory before starting application
              cd "$$ORIGINAL_DIR"

              ./start.sh
        environment:
            CERT_INFO_COUNTRY_NAME: ${CERT_INFO_COUNTRY_NAME:-DO}
            CERT_INFO_EMAIL: ${CERT_INFO_EMAIL:-example@gmail.com}
            CERT_INFO_LOCALITY_NAME: ${CERT_INFO_LOCALITY_NAME:-Santiago}
            CERT_INFO_ORGANIZATION_NAME: ${CERT_INFO_ORGANIZATION_NAME:-Example INC}
            CERT_INFO_ORGANIZATIONAL_UNIT: ${CERT_INFO_ORGANIZATIONAL_UNIT:-IT Department}
            CERT_INFO_STATE_OR_PROVIDENCE: ${CERT_INFO_STATE_OR_PROVIDENCE:-Santiago}
            CERT_VALID_DAYS: ${CERT_VALID_DAYS:-365}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@database/${POSTGRES_DB:-documenso-db}?schema=public
            NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@database/${POSTGRES_DB:-documenso-db}?schema=public
            NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${SERVICE_BASE64_ENCRYPTIONKEY}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY: ${SERVICE_BASE64_SECONDARYENCRYPTIONKEY}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_RESEND_API_KEY: ${NEXT_PRIVATE_RESEND_API_KEY}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PASSPHRASE: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DOCUMENSO}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_LOCAL_FILE_PATH: /app/certs/cert.p12
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DOCUMENSO}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_TRANSPORT: local
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS: ${NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_NAME: ${NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_NAME}

            NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT: ${NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT}
            NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME: ${NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_SIGNUP: ${DISABLE_LOGIN:-false}
            NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_DOCUMENSO}
            NEXTAUTH_SECRET: ${SERVICE_BASE64_AUTHSECRET}

        healthcheck:
            interval: 2s

services:

            timeout: 10s
        image: elastic/elasticsearch:9.1.2
        volumes:
            - source: data-elasticsearch-1
              target: /usr/share/elasticsearch/data
              type: volume
    kibana:
        depends_on:
            elasticsearch:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS: http://elasticsearch:9200
            ELASTICSEARCH_SERVICEACCOUNTTOKEN: ${ELASTICSEARCH_SERVICEACCOUNTTOKEN}
            KIBANA_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_KIBANA}
            SERVER_NAME: ${SERVICE_FQDN_KIBANA}
            SERVER_PUBLICBASEURL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_KIBANA}
            SERVICE_FQDN_KIBANA_5601: ${SERVICE_FQDN_KIBANA_5601}
            TELEMETRY_OPTIN: ${TELEMETRY_OPTIN:-false}
            XPACK.SECURITY.ENABLED: "true"
            XPACK_ENCRYPTEDSAVEDOBJECTS_ENCRYPTIONKEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_XPACKENCRYPTEDSAVEDOBJECTS}
            XPACK_REPORTING_ENCRYPTIONKEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_XPACKREPORTING}
            XPACK_SECURITY_ENCRYPTIONKEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_XPACKSECURITY}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 120
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - curl -s -I http://localhost:5601 | grep -q 'HTTP/1.1 302 Found'
            timeout: 10s
        image: kibana:9.1.2
        volumes:
            - source: data-kibana-1
              target: /usr/share/kibana/data
              type: volume
    kibana-token-generator:
        depends_on:
            elasticsearch:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |-
              apk add --no-cache curl jq >/dev/null 2>&1
              echo "Generating Kibana service token..."
              RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -u elastic:"$${ELASTIC_PASSWORD}" -X POST "http://elasticsearch:9200/_security/service/elastic/kibana/credential/token/kibana-service-token")
              HTTP_CODE=$$(echo "$${RESPONSE}" | tail -n1)
              BODY=$$(echo "$${RESPONSE}" | head -n -1)
              if [ "$${HTTP_CODE}" = "200" ]; then
                CREATED=$$(echo "$${BODY}" | jq -r '.created')
                if [ "$${CREATED}" = "true" ]; then
                  TOKEN_VALUE=$$(echo "$${BODY}" | jq -r '.token.value')
                  echo "Token created successfully:"
                  echo "$${TOKEN_VALUE}"
                else
                  echo "Unexpected response, token not created:"
                  echo "$${BODY}"
                fi
              elif [ "$${HTTP_CODE}" = "409" ]; then
                echo "Token already exists. Skipping token creation."
              else
                echo "Failed to create token. HTTP code: $${HTTP_CODE}"
                echo "$${BODY}"
                exit 1
              fi
        environment:
            ELASTIC_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ELASTICSEARCH}
        image: alpine:latest
        restart: "no"
volumes:
    data-elasticsearch-1: {}
    data-kibana-1: {}

services.name: Forgejo With Runner
services.description: Forgejo is a self-hosted lightweight software forge. Easy to install and low maintenance, it just does the job.
services.supportNote: Needs privileged access after deploy
services.compose:
services:
    docker-in-docker:
        environment:
            DOCKER_HOST: docker-in-docker
            DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: /certs
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - docker
                - -H
                - unix:///var/run/docker.sock
                - info
            timeout: 30s
        hostname: docker
        image: docker:dind
        volumes:
            - source: data-docker-in-docker-0
              target: /certs
              type: volume
    forgejo:
        command: bash -c ' /usr/bin/s6-svscan /etc/s6 & until su -c "forgejo forgejo-cli actions register --keep-labels --secret $${RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET:0:40}" git ; do sleep 5 ; done ; su -c "forgejo admin user create --admin --username \"$$FORGEJO_ADMIN_USER\" --password \"$$FORGEJO_ADMIN_PASSWORD\" --email \"$$FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL\" --must-change-password=false" git || true ; touch /tmp/runner-registered ; wait '
        environment:
            FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOW_LOCALNETWORKS: ${FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOW_LOCALNETWORKS:-false}
            FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOWED_DOMAINS: ${FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOWED_DOMAINS}
            FORGEJO__repository__DEFAULT_PUSH_CREATE_PRIVATE: "false"
            FORGEJO__repository__DEFAULT_REPO_UNITS: repo.code,repo.actions
            FORGEJO__repository__ENABLE_PUSH_CREATE_USER: "true"
            FORGEJO__security__INSTALL_LOCK: "true"
            FORGEJO__server__DOMAIN: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO}
            FORGEJO__server__ROOT_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO}
            FORGEJO__server__SSH_DOMAIN: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO}
            FORGEJO__server__SSH_PORT: ${FORGEJO_SSH_PORT:-22222}
            FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL:-admin@example.com}
            FORGEJO_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}
            FORGEJO_ADMIN_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}
            RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET: ${SERVICE_HEX_64_RUNNER}
            SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO_3000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO_3000}
            USER_GID: "1000"
            USER_UID: "1000"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 30
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:3000 > /dev/null && test -f /tmp/runner-registered
            timeout: 10s
        image: codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:15
        ports:
            - ${FORGEJO_SSH_PORT:-22222}:22
        volumes:
            - source: data-forgejo-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
            - read_only: true
              source: data-forgejo-1
              target: /etc/timezone
              type: volume
            - read_only: true
              source: data-forgejo-2
              target: /etc/localtime
              type: volume
    runner:
        command: forgejo-runner --config config.yml daemon
        depends_on:
            docker-in-docker:
                condition: service_healthy
            forgejo:
                condition: service_healthy
            runner-register:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
        environment:
            DOCKER_CERT_PATH: /certs/client
            DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376
            DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: "1"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - pgrep
                - forgejo-runner
            timeout: 30s
        image: data.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.0
        user: 1000:1000
        volumes:
            - source: data-runner-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
            - source: data-runner-1
              target: /certs
              type: volume
    runner-register:
        command: 'bash -ec '' secret=$${RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET:0:40} ; uuid=$$(printf %s "$${secret:0:16}" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d " \n" | sed -E "s/(.{8})(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.{12})/\1-\2-\3-\4-\5/") ; forgejo-runner generate-config > config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|  labels: \[\]|  labels: [\"docker:docker://node:22-bookworm\", \"ubuntu-latest:docker://catthehacker/ubuntu:act-22.04\", \"ubuntu-22.04:docker://catthehacker/ubuntu:act-22.04\"]|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|network: .*|network: host|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|^  envs:$$|  envs:\n    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376\n    DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: 1\n    DOCKER_CERT_PATH: /certs/client|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|^  options:|  options: -v /certs/client:/certs/client|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|  valid_volumes: \[\]$$|  valid_volumes:\n    - /certs/client|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|  connections:|  connections:\n    default:\n      url: http://forgejo:3000\n      uuid: $$uuid\n      token: $$secret|" config.yml ; chown -R 1000:1000 /data '''
        environment:
            RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET: ${SERVICE_HEX_64_RUNNER}
        image: data.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.0
        restart: "no"
        user: "0:0"
        volumes:
            - source: data-runner-register-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
volumes:
    data-docker-in-docker-0: {}
    data-forgejo-0: {}
    data-forgejo-1: {}
    data-forgejo-2: {}
    data-runner-0: {}
    data-runner-1: {}
    data-runner-register-0: {}

services.name: Forgejo With Runner With Postgresql
services.description: Forgejo is a self-hosted lightweight software forge. Easy to install and low maintenance, it just does the job.
services.supportNote: Needs privileged access after deploy
services.compose:
services:
    docker-in-docker:
        environment:
            DOCKER_HOST: docker-in-docker
            DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: /certs
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - docker
                - -H
                - unix:///var/run/docker.sock
                - info
            timeout: 30s
        hostname: docker
        image: docker:dind
        volumes:
            - source: data-docker-in-docker-0
              target: /certs
              type: volume
    forgejo:
        command: bash -c ' /usr/bin/s6-svscan /etc/s6 & until su -c "forgejo forgejo-cli actions register --keep-labels --secret $${RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET:0:40}" git ; do sleep 5 ; done ; su -c "forgejo admin user create --admin --username \"$$FORGEJO_ADMIN_USER\" --password \"$$FORGEJO_ADMIN_PASSWORD\" --email \"$$FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL\" --must-change-password=false" git || true ; touch /tmp/runner-registered ; wait '
        depends_on:
            postgresql:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            FORGEJO__database__DB_TYPE: postgres
            FORGEJO__database__HOST: postgresql
            FORGEJO__database__NAME: ${POSTGRESQL_DATABASE:-forgejo}
            FORGEJO__database__PASSWD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRESQL}
            FORGEJO__database__USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRESQL}
            FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOW_LOCALNETWORKS: ${FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOW_LOCALNETWORKS:-false}
            FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOWED_DOMAINS: ${FORGEJO__migrations__ALLOWED_DOMAINS}
            FORGEJO__repository__DEFAULT_PUSH_CREATE_PRIVATE: "false"
            FORGEJO__repository__DEFAULT_REPO_UNITS: repo.code,repo.actions
            FORGEJO__repository__ENABLE_PUSH_CREATE_USER: "true"
            FORGEJO__security__INSTALL_LOCK: "true"
            FORGEJO__server__DOMAIN: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO}
            FORGEJO__server__ROOT_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO}
            FORGEJO__server__SSH_DOMAIN: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO}
            FORGEJO__server__SSH_PORT: ${FORGEJO_SSH_PORT:-22222}
            FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL:-admin@example.com}
            FORGEJO_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}
            FORGEJO_ADMIN_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}
            RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET: ${SERVICE_HEX_64_RUNNER}
            SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO_3000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_FORGEJO_3000}
            USER_GID: "1000"
            USER_UID: "1000"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 30
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:3000 > /dev/null && test -f /tmp/runner-registered
            timeout: 10s
        image: codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:15
        ports:
            - ${FORGEJO_SSH_PORT:-22222}:22
        volumes:
            - source: data-forgejo-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
            - read_only: true
              source: data-forgejo-1
              target: /etc/timezone
              type: volume
            - read_only: true
              source: data-forgejo-2
              target: /etc/localtime
              type: volume
    postgresql:
        environment:
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRESQL_DATABASE:-forgejo}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRESQL}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRESQL}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 20s
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-postgresql-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    runner:
        command: forgejo-runner --config config.yml daemon
        depends_on:
            docker-in-docker:
                condition: service_healthy
            forgejo:
                condition: service_healthy
            runner-register:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
        environment:
            DOCKER_CERT_PATH: /certs/client
            DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376
            DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: "1"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD
                - pgrep
                - forgejo-runner
            timeout: 30s
        image: data.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.0
        user: 1000:1000
        volumes:
            - source: data-runner-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
            - source: data-runner-1
              target: /certs
              type: volume
    runner-register:
        command: 'bash -ec '' secret=$${RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET:0:40} ; uuid=$$(printf %s "$${secret:0:16}" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d " \n" | sed -E "s/(.{8})(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.{12})/\1-\2-\3-\4-\5/") ; forgejo-runner generate-config > config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|  labels: \[\]|  labels: [\"docker:docker://node:22-bookworm\", \"ubuntu-latest:docker://catthehacker/ubuntu:act-22.04\", \"ubuntu-22.04:docker://catthehacker/ubuntu:act-22.04\"]|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|network: .*|network: host|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|^  envs:$$|  envs:\n    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2376\n    DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: 1\n    DOCKER_CERT_PATH: /certs/client|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|^  options:|  options: -v /certs/client:/certs/client|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|  valid_volumes: \[\]$$|  valid_volumes:\n    - /certs/client|" config.yml ; sed -i -e "s|  connections:|  connections:\n    default:\n      url: http://forgejo:3000\n      uuid: $$uuid\n      token: $$secret|" config.yml ; chown -R 1000:1000 /data '''
        environment:
            RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET: ${SERVICE_HEX_64_RUNNER}
        image: data.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.0
        restart: "no"
        user: "0:0"
        volumes:
            - source: data-runner-register-0
              target: /data
              type: volume

services.description: Hatchet allows you to run background tasks at scale with a high-throughput, low-latency computing service built on an open-source, fault-tolerant queue.
services.compose:
services:
    hatchet-dashboard:
        command: sh ./entrypoint.sh --config /hatchet/config
        depends_on:
            migration:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            rabbitmq:
                condition: service_healthy
            setup-config:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
        environment:
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-hatchet}
            SERVER_AUTH_SET_EMAIL_VERIFIED: ${SERVER_AUTH_SET_EMAIL_VERIFIED:-true}
            SERVICE_FQDN_HATCHET_80: ${SERVICE_FQDN_HATCHET_80}
        image: ghcr.io/hatchet-dev/hatchet/hatchet-dashboard:latest
        volumes:
            - source: data-hatchet-dashboard-0
              target: /hatchet/certs
              type: volume
            - source: data-hatchet-dashboard-1
              target: /hatchet/config
              type: volume
    hatchet-engine:
        command: /hatchet/hatchet-engine --config /hatchet/config
        depends_on:
            migration:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            rabbitmq:
                condition: service_healthy
            setup-config:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
        environment:
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-hatchet}
            SERVER_GRPC_BIND_ADDRESS: ${SERVER_GRPC_BIND_ADDRESS:-0.0.0.0}
            SERVER_GRPC_INSECURE: ${SERVER_GRPC_INSECURE:-t}
        image: ghcr.io/hatchet-dev/hatchet/hatchet-engine:latest
        restart: on-failure
        volumes:
            - source: data-hatchet-engine-0
              target: /hatchet/certs
              type: volume
            - source: data-hatchet-engine-1
              target: /hatchet/config
              type: volume
    migration:
        command: /hatchet/hatchet-migrate
        depends_on:
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-hatchet}
        image: ghcr.io/hatchet-dev/hatchet/hatchet-migrate:latest
        restart: "no"
    postgres:
        environment:
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-hatchet}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 20s
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-postgres-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    rabbitmq:
        environment:
            PORT: ${RABBITMQ_PORT:-5672}
            RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_RABBITMQ}
            RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_RABBITMQ}
            SERVICE_FQDN_RABBITMQ_15672: ${SERVICE_FQDN_RABBITMQ_15672}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 20
            start_period: 60s
            test: rabbitmq-diagnostics -q check_port_connectivity
            timeout: 30s
        hostname: rabbitmq
        image: rabbitmq:3-management
        volumes:
            - source: data-rabbitmq-0
              target: /var/lib/rabbitmq/
              type: volume
    setup-config:
        command: /hatchet/hatchet-admin quickstart --skip certs --generated-config-dir /hatchet/config --overwrite=false
        depends_on:
            migration:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
            rabbitmq:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DATABASE_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-hatchet}
            SERVER_AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN: ${SERVER_AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN:-localhost:8080}
            SERVER_AUTH_COOKIE_INSECURE: ${SERVER_AUTH_COOKIE_INSECURE:-t}

services.description: Honcho is a developer tool to build personalized AI agents with production-ready memory, dialectic reasoning, and stateful dialogue.
services.compose:
services:
    api:
        depends_on:
            database:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - sh
            - docker/entrypoint.sh
        environment:
            AUTH_USE_AUTH: "false"
            CACHE_ENABLED: "true"
            CACHE_URL: redis://redis:6379/0?suppress=true
            DB_CONNECTION_URI: postgresql+psycopg://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@database:5432/postgres

            SERVICE_FQDN_API_8000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_API_8000}
            VECTOR_STORE_TYPE: pgvector
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 30s
            test:
                - CMD
                - /app/.venv/bin/python
                - -c
                - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/health', timeout=2).read()
            timeout: 5s
        image: ghcr.io/plastic-labs/honcho:v3.0.12
    database:
        environment:
            POSTGRES_DB: postgres
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 5s
        image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
        volumes:
            - source: data-database-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data/
              type: volume
    deriver:
        depends_on:
            api:
                condition: service_healthy
            database:
                condition: service_healthy
            redis:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - /app/.venv/bin/python
            - -m
            - src.deriver
        environment:
            AUTH_USE_AUTH: "false"
            CACHE_ENABLED: "true"
            CACHE_URL: redis://redis:6379/0?suppress=true
            DB_CONNECTION_URI: postgresql+psycopg://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@database:5432/postgres
            LLM_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${LLM_OPENAI_API_KEY}
            LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
            VECTOR_STORE_TYPE: pgvector
        image: ghcr.io/plastic-labs/honcho:v3.0.12
    redis:
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - redis-cli ping
            timeout: 5s
        image: redis:8.2
        volumes:

            DOMAIN_SERVER: ${SERVICE_FQDN_LIBRECHAT}

            HOST: 0.0.0.0
            JWT_REFRESH_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_JWT}
            JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_JWT}

            MEILI_MASTER_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MEILI}
            MONGO_URI: mongodb://${SERVICE_USER_MONGO}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MONGO}@mongodb:27017/librechat?authSource=admin
            NO_INDEX: ${NO_INDEX:-true}
            OPENAI_API_KEY: ${SERVICE_OPENAI_API_KEY:-user_provided}
            PORT: "3080"
            RAG_API_URL: http://rag-api:8000
            RAG_PORT: "8000"
            SERVICE_FQDN_LIBRECHAT_3080: ${SERVICE_FQDN_LIBRECHAT_3080}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD
                - wget
                - --no-verbose
                - --tries=1
                - --spider
                - http://127.0.0.1:3080/health
            timeout: 10s
        image: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat-dev-api:6ecd1b510faaa593ad954fb6276c18e5f12a8e53
        volumes:
            - source: data-librechat-0
              target: /app/client/public/images
              type: volume
            - source: data-librechat-1
              target: /app/api/logs
              type: volume
            - source: data-librechat-2
              target: /app/uploads
              type: volume
            - source: data-librechat-3
              target: /app/librechat.yaml
              type: volume
    meilisearch:
        environment:
            MEILI_ENV: production
            MEILI_HOST: http://meilisearch:7700
            MEILI_MASTER_KEY: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MEILI}
            MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS: ${MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS:-false}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 2s
            retries: 15
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - -f

            timeout: 10s

            MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: ${SERVICE_USER_MONGO}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - mongosh
                - --eval
                - db.runCommand('ping').ok
                - 127.0.0.1:27017/test
                - --quiet
            timeout: 10s
        image: mongo:8
        volumes:
            - source: data-mongodb-0
              target: /data/db
              type: volume
    rag-api:
        depends_on:
            vectordb:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DB_HOST: vectordb
            DB_NAME: rag
            DB_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            DB_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_DB: rag

            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
            RAG_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${SERVICE_OPENAI_API_KEY:-user_provided}

            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD

                - -c
                - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health')
            timeout: 10s
        image: ghcr.io/danny-avila/librechat-rag-api-dev-lite:v0.7.3

            POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}

            interval: 2s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 10s
            test:
                - CMD
                - pg_isready
                - --username=$SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES

services.name: Matrix Synapse With Postgresql
services.description: Chat securely with your family, friends, community, or build great apps with Matrix!
services.compose:
services:
    postgres:
        environment:
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-synapse-db}
            POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: --encoding=UTF8 --lc-collate=C --lc-ctype=C
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRESQL}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRESQL}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB:-synapse-db}
            timeout: 5s
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-postgres-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    synapse:
        depends_on:
            postgres:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - /bin/bash
            - -c
            - |
              ! test -f /data/homeserver.yaml && /start.py generate

              # Extract secrets from generated config
              grep "registration_shared_secret" /data/homeserver.yaml \
              | awk '{print $2}' > ./registration_shared_secret

              grep "macaroon_secret_key" /data/homeserver.yaml \
              | awk '{print $2}' > ./macaroon_secret_key

              grep "form_secret" /data/homeserver.yaml \
              | awk '{print $2}' > ./form_secret

              # Create homeserver.yaml with PostgreSQL
              cat <<EOF > /data/homeserver.yaml
              server_name: "${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME}"
              pid_file: /data/homeserver.pid
              public_baseurl: "${SERVICE_FQDN_SYNAPSE}/"

              listeners:
                - port: 8008
                  tls: false
                  type: http
                  x_forwarded: true
                  bind_addresses: ['0.0.0.0']
                  resources:
                    - names: [client, federation]
                      compress: false

              database:
                name: psycopg2
                args:
                  user: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRESQL}
                  password: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRESQL}
                  database: ${POSTGRES_DB:-synapse-db}
                  host: postgres
                  port: 5432
                  cp_min: 5
                  cp_max: 10

              log_config: "/data/${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME}.log.config"
              media_store_path: /data/media_store
              report_stats: ${SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS}

              registration_shared_secret: $(<./registration_shared_secret)
              macaroon_secret_key: $(<./macaroon_secret_key)
              form_secret: $(<./form_secret)
              signing_key_path: "/data/${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME}.signing.key"

              trusted_key_servers:
                - server_name: "matrix.org"
              EOF

              [ "${ENABLE_REGISTRATION}" = "true" ] && ! grep "#registration" /data/homeserver.yaml &>/dev/null \
              && echo >> /data/homeserver.yaml \
              && cat <<EOF >> /data/homeserver.yaml
              enable_registration: true
              EOF

              # Register admin user if provided
              register_admin(){
                while ! curl -sf http://localhost:8008/health > /dev/null; do
                  sleep 2
                done
                register_new_matrix_user \
                  -a \
                  -u ${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN} \
                  -p ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN} \
                  -c /data/homeserver.yaml \
                  http://localhost:8008 &>/dev/null
              }
              [ -n "${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}" ] && register_admin &

              /start.py
        environment:
            ENABLE_REGISTRATION: ${ENABLE_REGISTRATION:-false}
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-synapse-db}
            SERVICE_FQDN_SYNAPSE_8008: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SYNAPSE_8008}
            SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}
            SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRESQL: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRESQL}
            SERVICE_USER_ADMIN: ${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}
            SERVICE_USER_POSTGRESQL: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRESQL}
            SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS: ${SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS:-no}
            SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME: ${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME:?}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 10
            start_period: 10s

services.name: Matrix Synapse With Sqlite
services.description: Chat securely with your family, friends, community, or build great apps with Matrix!
services.compose:
services:
    synapse:
        command:
            - -c
            - |-
              # Generate config on first run
              if [ ! -f /data/homeserver.yaml ]; then
                # Generate default config using SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME (permanent, used in user IDs)
                /start.py generate

                # Set public_baseurl to actual deployment URL (may differ from server_name)
                # This allows hosting at matrix.example.org while server_name is example.org
                if ! grep -q "public_baseurl" /data/homeserver.yaml; then
                  sed -i "/^server_name:/a public_baseurl: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SYNAPSE}/" /data/homeserver.yaml
                fi

                # Configure listener for reverse proxy
                sed -i 's/bind_addresses: \[.*\]/bind_addresses: ["0.0.0.0"]/' /data/homeserver.yaml
                sed -i '/x_forwarded:/d' /data/homeserver.yaml
                sed -i '/type: http/a \    x_forwarded: true' /data/homeserver.yaml

                # Enable registration if requested
                if [ "${ENABLE_REGISTRATION}" = "true" ] && ! grep -q "enable_registration" /data/homeserver.yaml; then
                  echo "enable_registration: true" >> /data/homeserver.yaml
                fi
              fi

              # Register admin user if credentials provided
              if [ -n "${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}" ] && [ -n "${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}" ]; then
                (
                  while ! curl -sf http://localhost:8008/health > /dev/null 2>&1; do
                    sleep 2
                  done
                  register_new_matrix_user -a \
                    -u "${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}" \
                    -p "${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}" \
                    -c /data/homeserver.yaml \
                    http://localhost:8008 2>/dev/null || true
                ) &
              fi

              exec /start.py
        entrypoint: /bin/bash
        environment:
            ENABLE_REGISTRATION: ${ENABLE_REGISTRATION:-false}
            SERVICE_FQDN_SYNAPSE_8008: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SYNAPSE_8008}
            SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_ADMIN}
            SERVICE_USER_ADMIN: ${SERVICE_USER_ADMIN}
            SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS: ${SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS:-no}
            SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME: ${SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME:?}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 5
            start_period: 20s
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - -f
                - http://localhost:8008/health
            timeout: 10s
        image: matrixdotorg/synapse:latest
        volumes:

        environment:
            ALLOW_ANONYMOUS: ${ALLOW_ANONYMOUS:-true}
            MQTT_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_MOSQUITTO}
            MQTT_USERNAME: ${SERVICE_USER_MOSQUITTO}
            REQUIRE_CERTIFICATE: ${REQUIRE_CERTIFICATE:-false}
            SERVICE_FQDN_MOSQUITTO_1883: ${SERVICE_FQDN_MOSQUITTO_1883}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - exit 0
            timeout: 10s
        image: eclipse-mosquitto
        ports:
            - 8883:8883
        volumes:
            - source: data-mosquitto-0
              target: /mosquitto/config

            DATABASE_PORT: "5432"
            DATABASE_SYNCHRONIZE: "false"
            DATABASE_TYPE: postgres
            DATABASE_USERNAME: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
            ENGINE_TYPE: ${ENGINE_TYPE:-whatsapp-web.js}
            HOME: /tmp
            LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
            NODE_ENV: production
            PORT: "2785"
            POSTGRES_SCHEMA: public
            PUPPETEER_ARGS: --no-sandbox,--disable-setuid-sandbox,--disable-dev-shm-usage
            PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH: /usr/local/bin/puppeteer-chrome
            PUPPETEER_HEADLESS: "true"
            QUEUE_ENABLED: "true"
            REDIS_ENABLED: "true"
            REDIS_HOST: openwa-redis
            REDIS_PORT: "6379"
            SERVICE_FQDN_OPENWA_2785: ${SERVICE_FQDN_OPENWA_2785}
            SESSION_DATA_PATH: ./data/sessions
            STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH: ./data/media
            STORAGE_TYPE: local
            XDG_CACHE_HOME: /tmp/.cache
            XDG_CONFIG_HOME: /tmp/.config
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 3
            start_period: 45s
            test:
                - CMD
                - node
                - -e
                - 'require(''http'').get(''http://localhost:2785/api/health/ready'', (r) => process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1))'
            timeout: 10s
        image: ghcr.io/rmyndharis/openwa:0.23.1
        mem_limit: ${OPENWA_MEM_LIMIT:-2g}
        pids_limit: ${OPENWA_PIDS_LIMIT:-2048}

            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}

            interval: 5s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL

            timeout: 3s

        restart: unless-stopped
        volumes:

services.name: Rocket.Chat
services.description: Self-hosted, secure and highly customizable open-source communication platform for organizations with sophisticated security and privacy concerns.
