services:
    mongodb:
        command: |
            sh -c "
              mongod --replSet ${MONGODB_REPLICA_SET_NAME:-rs0} --bind_ip_all &
              sleep 5 &&
              mongosh --eval 'rs.initiate({_id:\"${MONGODB_REPLICA_SET_NAME:-rs0}\", members:[{_id:0, host:\"mongodb:27017\"}]})' ||
              true &&
              wait
            "
        healthcheck:
            interval: 2s
            retries: 15
            test:
                - CMD
                - mongosh
                - --quiet
                - --eval
                - db.adminCommand('ping')
            timeout: 10s
        image: mongo:7
        volumes:
            - source: data-mongodb-0
              target: /data/db
              type: volume
    rocketchat:
        depends_on:
            mongodb:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DEPLOY_METHOD: docker
            MAIL_URL: ${MAIL_URL:-test@example.com}
            MONGO_OPLOG_URL: mongodb://${MONGODB_ADVERTISED_HOSTNAME:-mongodb}:${MONGODB_INITIAL_PRIMARY_PORT_NUMBER:-27017}/local?replicaSet=${MONGODB_REPLICA_SET_NAME:-rs0}
            MONGO_URL: mongodb://${MONGODB_ADVERTISED_HOSTNAME:-mongodb}:${MONGODB_INITIAL_PRIMARY_PORT_NUMBER:-27017}/${MONGODB_DATABASE:-rocketchat}?replicaSet=${MONGODB_REPLICA_SET_NAME:-rs0}
            REG_TOKEN: $$REG_TOKEN
            ROOT_URL: ${SERVICE_FQDN_ROCKETCHAT}
            SERVICE_FQDN_ROCKETCHAT_3000: ${SERVICE_FQDN_ROCKETCHAT_3000}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 2s
            retries: 15
            test:
                - CMD
                - node
                - --eval
                - 'const http = require(''http''); const options = { host: ''0.0.0.0'', port: 3000, timeout: 2000, path: ''/health'' }; const healthCheck = http.request(options, (res) => { console.log(''HEALTHCHECK STATUS:'', res.statusCode); if (res.statusCode == 200) { process.exit(0); } else { process.exit(1); } }); healthCheck.on(''error'', function (err) { console.error(''ERROR''); process.exit(1); }); healthCheck.end();'
            timeout: 10s
        image: registry.rocket.chat/rocketchat/rocket.chat:8.0.1
volumes:
    data-mongodb-0: {}

services.name: SigNoz
services.description: An observability platform native to OpenTelemetry with logs, traces and metrics.
services.supportNote: Needs host access and local configuration files after deploy
services.compose:
services:
    clickhouse:
        depends_on:
            init-clickhouse:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
            zookeeper:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            CLICKHOUSE_SKIP_USER_SETUP: "1"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - wget
                - -q
                - -O-
                - 0.0.0.0:8123/ping
            timeout: 5s
        image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.12.5-alpine
        logging:
            options:
                max-file: "3"
                max-size: 50m
        tty: true
        ulimits:
            nofile:
                hard: 262144
                soft: 262144
            nproc: 65535
        volumes:
            - source: clickhouse
              target: /var/lib/clickhouse/
              type: volume
            - read_only: true
              source: user-scripts
              target: /var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts
              type: volume
            - source: data-clickhouse-2
              target: /etc/clickhouse-server/custom-function.xml
              type: volume
            - source: data-clickhouse-3
              target: /etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/cluster.xml
              type: volume
    init-clickhouse:
        command:
            - bash
            - -c
            - |
              version="v0.0.1"
              node_os=$$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
              node_arch=$$(uname -m | sed s/aarch64/arm64/ | sed s/x86_64/amd64/)
              echo "Fetching histogram-binary for $${node_os}/$${node_arch}"
              cd /tmp
              wget -O histogram-quantile.tar.gz "https://github.com/SigNoz/signoz/releases/download/histogram-quantile%2F$${version}/histogram-quantile_$${node_os}_$${node_arch}.tar.gz"
              tar -xvzf histogram-quantile.tar.gz
              mv histogram-quantile /var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts/histogramQuantile
        image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:25.12.5-alpine
        logging:
            options:
                max-file: "3"
                max-size: 50m
        restart: on-failure
        volumes:
            - source: user-scripts
              target: /var/lib/clickhouse/user_scripts
              type: volume
    otel-collector:
        command:
            - -c
            - |
              set -e
              cat > /tmp/otel-config.yaml <<'SIGNOZ_CFG'
              connectors:
                signozmeter:
                  metrics_flush_interval: 1h
                  dimensions:
                    - name: service.name
                    - name: deployment.environment
                    - name: host.name
              receivers:
                otlp:
                  protocols:
                    grpc:
                      endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
                    http:
                      endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
                      auth:
                        authenticator: basicauth/server
              processors:
                batch:
                  send_batch_size: 50000
                  send_batch_max_size: 55000
                  timeout: 5s
                batch/meter:
                  send_batch_size: 20000
                  send_batch_max_size: 25000
                  timeout: 5s
                signozspanmetrics/delta:
                  metrics_exporter: signozclickhousemetrics
                  metrics_flush_interval: 60s
                  latency_histogram_buckets: [100us, 1ms, 2ms, 6ms, 10ms, 50ms, 100ms, 250ms, 500ms, 1000ms, 1400ms, 2000ms, 5s, 10s, 20s, 40s, 60s]
                  dimensions_cache_size: 100000
                  aggregation_temporality: AGGREGATION_TEMPORALITY_DELTA
                  enable_exp_histogram: true
                  dimensions:
                    - name: service.namespace
                      default: default
                    - name: deployment.environment
                      default: default
                    # This is added to ensure the uniqueness of the timeseries
                    # Otherwise, identical timeseries produced by multiple replicas of
                    # collectors result in incorrect APM metrics
                    - name: signoz.collector.id
                    - name: service.version
              exporters:
                clickhousetraces:
                  datasource: tcp://clickhouse:9000/signoz_traces
                  low_cardinal_exception_grouping: false
                  use_new_schema: true
                  timeout: 45s
                  sending_queue:
                    enabled: false
                signozclickhousemetrics:
                  dsn: tcp://clickhouse:9000/signoz_metrics
                  timeout: 45s
                  sending_queue:
                    enabled: false
                clickhouselogsexporter:
                  dsn: tcp://clickhouse:9000/signoz_logs
                  use_new_schema: true
                  timeout: 45s
                  sending_queue:
                    enabled: false
                signozclickhousemeter:
                  dsn: tcp://clickhouse:9000/signoz_meter
                  timeout: 45s
                  sending_queue:
                    enabled: false
                metadataexporter:
                  enabled: true
                  dsn: tcp://clickhouse:9000/signoz_metadata
                  timeout: 45s
                  cache:
                    provider: in_memory
              extensions:
                signoz_health_check:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133
                pprof:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:1777
                basicauth/server:
                  htpasswd:
                    inline: "$${env:OTEL_BASIC_AUTH}\n"
              service:
                telemetry:
                  logs:
                    encoding: json
                extensions:
                  - signoz_health_check
                  - pprof
                  - basicauth/server
                pipelines:
                  traces:
                    receivers: [otlp]
                    processors: [signozspanmetrics/delta, batch]
                    exporters: [clickhousetraces, signozmeter, metadataexporter]
                  metrics:
                    receivers: [otlp]
                    processors: [batch]
                    exporters: [signozclickhousemetrics, signozmeter, metadataexporter]
                  logs:
                    receivers: [otlp]
                    processors: [batch]
                    exporters: [clickhouselogsexporter, signozmeter, metadataexporter]
                  metrics/meter:
                    receivers: [signozmeter]
                    processors: [batch/meter]
                    exporters: [signozclickhousemeter]
              SIGNOZ_CFG
              cat > /tmp/opamp-config.yaml <<'SIGNOZ_OPAMP'
              server_endpoint: ws://signoz:4320/v1/opamp
              SIGNOZ_OPAMP
              /signoz-otel-collector migrate sync check
              exec /signoz-otel-collector --config=/tmp/otel-config.yaml --manager-config=/tmp/opamp-config.yaml --copy-path=/var/tmp/collector-config.yaml
        depends_on:
            clickhouse:
                condition: service_healthy
            signoz:
                condition: service_healthy
            telemetrystore-migrator:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
        entrypoint:
            - /bin/sh
        environment:
            LOW_CARDINAL_EXCEPTION_GROUPING: "false"
            OTEL_BASIC_AUTH: signoz:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_OTELAUTH}
            OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES: host.name=signoz-host,os.type=linux
            SERVICE_FQDN_OTELCOLLECTORHTTP_4318: ${SERVICE_FQDN_OTELCOLLECTORHTTP_4318}
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER: cluster
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_DSN: tcp://clickhouse:9000
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_REPLICATION: "true"
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_TIMEOUT: 10m
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 3
            test: bash -c "exec 6<> /dev/tcp/localhost/13133"
            timeout: 5s
        image: signoz/signoz-otel-collector:v0.144.8
        logging:
            options:
                max-file: "3"
                max-size: 50m
    signoz:
        depends_on:
            clickhouse:
                condition: service_healthy
            telemetrystore-migrator:
                condition: service_completed_successfully
        environment:
            DEPLOYMENT_TYPE: docker-standalone-amd
            DOT_METRICS_ENABLED: "true"
            GODEBUG: netdns=go
            SERVICE_FQDN_SIGNOZ_8080: ${SERVICE_FQDN_SIGNOZ_8080}
            SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_PROVIDER: signoz
            SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__AUTH__PASSWORD: ${SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__AUTH__PASSWORD}
            SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__AUTH__USERNAME: ${SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__AUTH__USERNAME}
            SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__FROM: ${SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__FROM}
            SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__SMARTHOST: ${SIGNOZ_ALERTMANAGER_SIGNOZ_GLOBAL_SMTP__SMARTHOST}
            SIGNOZ_EMAILING_ENABLED: ${SIGNOZ_EMAILING_ENABLED:-false}
            SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_ADDRESS: ${SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_ADDRESS}
            SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_AUTH_PASSWORD: ${SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_AUTH_PASSWORD}
            SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_AUTH_USERNAME: ${SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_AUTH_USERNAME}
            SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_FROM: ${SIGNOZ_EMAILING_SMTP_FROM}
            SIGNOZ_SQLSTORE_PROVIDER: sqlite
            SIGNOZ_SQLSTORE_SQLITE_PATH: /var/lib/signoz/signoz.db
            SIGNOZ_STATSREPORTER_ENABLED: ${SIGNOZ_STATSREPORTER_ENABLED:-true}
            SIGNOZ_TELEMETRYSTORE_CLICKHOUSE_DSN: tcp://clickhouse:9000
            SIGNOZ_TELEMETRYSTORE_PROVIDER: clickhouse
            SIGNOZ_TOKENIZER_JWT_SECRET: ${SERVICE_REALBASE64_JWTSECRET}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD
                - wget
                - --spider
                - -q
                - localhost:8080/api/v1/health
            timeout: 5s
        image: signoz/signoz:v0.137.1
        logging:
            options:
                max-file: "3"
                max-size: 50m
        volumes:
            - source: sqlite
              target: /var/lib/signoz/
              type: volume
    telemetrystore-migrator:
        command:
            - |
              /signoz-otel-collector migrate bootstrap --clickhouse-dsn tcp://clickhouse:9000 &&
              /signoz-otel-collector migrate sync up --clickhouse-dsn tcp://clickhouse:9000 &&
              /signoz-otel-collector migrate async up --clickhouse-dsn tcp://clickhouse:9000
        depends_on:
            clickhouse:
                condition: service_healthy
        entrypoint:
            - /bin/sh
            - -c
        environment:
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER: cluster
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_DSN: tcp://clickhouse:9000
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_CLICKHOUSE_REPLICATION: "true"
            SIGNOZ_OTEL_COLLECTOR_TIMEOUT: 10m
        image: signoz/signoz-otel-collector:v0.144.8
        logging:
            options:
                max-file: "3"
                max-size: 50m
        restart: on-failure
    zookeeper:
        environment:
            ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_LOGIN: ${ZOO_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_LOGIN:-yes}
            ZOO_AUTOPURGE_INTERVAL: ${ZOO_AUTOPURGE_INTERVAL:-1}
            ZOO_ENABLE_PROMETHEUS_METRICS: ${ZOO_ENABLE_PROMETHEUS_METRICS:-yes}
            ZOO_PROMETHEUS_METRICS_PORT_NUMBER: ${ZOO_PROMETHEUS_METRICS_PORT_NUMBER:-9141}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 3
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:8080/commands/ruok | grep error | grep null
            timeout: 5s
        image: signoz/zookeeper:3.9.3
        logging:
            options:
                max-file: "3"
                max-size: 50m
        user: root
        volumes:
            - source: data-zookeeper-0
              target: /bitnami/zookeeper
              type: volume

services:
    clickhouse:

        volumes:
            - source: data-clickhouse-0
              target: /var/lib/clickhouse
              type: volume
            - source: data-clickhouse-1
              target: /var/log/clickhouse-server
              type: volume
    docker-proxy:
        environment:
            AUTH: ${AUTH:-1}
            CONTAINERS: ${CONTAINERS:-1}
            DISTRIBUTION: ${DISTRIBUTION:-1}
            IMAGES: ${IMAGES:-1}
            INFO: ${INFO:-1}
            LOG_LEVEL: info
            NETWORKS: ${NETWORKS:-1}
            POST: ${POST:-1}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 30s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - nc -z 127.0.0.1 2375 || exit 1
            timeout: 5s
        image: tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy:v0.4.2
        volumes: []
    electric:
        depends_on:
            postgresql:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}@postgresql:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-trigger-db}?sslmode=disable
            ELECTRIC_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_ELECTRIC}
            ELECTRIC_USAGE_REPORTING: "false"
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD
                - curl
                - -f
                - http://localhost:3000/v1/health
            timeout: 5s
        image: electricsql/electric:1.2.9
    postgresql:
        command:
            - -c
            - wal_level=logical
        environment:
            POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-trigger-db}
            POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES}
            POSTGRES_USER: ${SERVICE_USER_POSTGRES}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 10
            test:
                - CMD-SHELL
                - pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}
            timeout: 20s
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-postgresql-0
              target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
              type: volume
    redis:
        healthcheck:
            interval: 10s
            retries: 5
            test:
                - CMD
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            timeout: 5s
        image: redis:7-alpine
        volumes:
            - source: data-redis-0
              target: /data
              type: volume
    supervisor:
        command: |
            sh -c "chown -R node:node /home/node/shared && exec /usr/bin/dumb-init -- pnpm run --filter supervisor start"
        depends_on:
            docker-proxy:
                condition: service_healthy
            trigger:
                condition: service_healthy
        environment:
            DEBUG: ${SUPERVISOR_DEBUG:-0}
            DOCKER_AUTOREMOVE_EXITED_CONTAINERS: ${DOCKER_AUTOREMOVE_EXITED_CONTAINERS:-1}
            DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker-proxy:2375

            MANAGED_WORKER_SECRET: ${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_WORKERSECRET}
            OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: http://trigger:3000/otel
            TRIGGER_API_URL: http://trigger:3000
            TRIGGER_DEQUEUE_INTERVAL_MS: "1000"
            TRIGGER_WORKER_TOKEN: ${TRIGGER_WORKER_TOKEN:-file:///home/node/shared/worker_token}
            TRIGGER_WORKLOAD_API_DOMAIN: ${TRIGGER_WORKLOAD_API_DOMAIN}
            TRIGGER_WORKLOAD_API_PORT_EXTERNAL: "8020"

                - require('http').get('http://127.0.0.1:8020/health',(r)=>process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))
